summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Auna S.A., a Luxembourg foreign private issuer, furnishing a convening notice for its annual general meeting of shareholders to be held on June 30, 2026. The agenda includes standard items such as approval of financial statements for FY2025, discharge of directors, reappointment of the statutory auditor, and ratification of director remuneration. No special-situation transaction is announced. As a routine meeting notice with no merger, acquisition, restructuring, or other extraordinary corporate event, this filing does not qualify as a special situation. The registrant is simply filing its required periodic report under the 1934 Act.
